What We Treat

Pest control services

One-time targeted services or flexible recurring plans — contract-free, or discounted with a contract. No hidden fees, ever.

Residential Pest Control

Targeted treatments for single-family homes, apartments, duplexes, condos, mobile homes — even vehicles and boats.

Roach & Ant Treatment

Roaches and ants are South Florida's biggest nuisance. We treat where they hide, not just where you see them.

Termite Control & WDO Inspections

No-tent termite treatment and WDO inspections to protect your home's structure and value.

Rodent Control

Rats and mice removed and kept out, with trapping and exclusion for lasting results.

Live Animal Trapping

Humane live trapping and removal when wildlife moves into your yard, attic or property.

Wasps & Stinging Insects

Nests in eaves, soffits and yards located and treated safely by our trained technicians.

Also available: bed bug control, flea & tick treatment, mosquito control, lawn pest control & fertilization, attic restoration, silverfish & whitefly treatment, and green pest control options.
